line.en: A system as small isometric buildings on a pale floor grid.

for.en: Systems and flows counted in blocks: supply chains, business processes, data pipelines, organisations, capacity and throughput.
for.zh-CN: 用方块计量的系统与流程：供应链、业务流程、数据流、组织结构、产能与吞吐。

not.en: Stories about people; history and nature.
